description: This file defines a Modal component for a React application, including related sub-components such as Warn and Trigger. It handles rendering modal dialogues with customizable headers, footers, content, and behavior, utilizing Radix UI's alert dialog primitives.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering a modal dialog with various customizable options.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Component displaying a warning modal, typically used for confirmation or alerts.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Component that renders children and triggers the display of a modal when clicked.
